performance_optimizations.title: Optimize Haptic Feedback Implementation
performance_optimizations.current_problem: Haptic feedback triggers on every tap and combo, causing performance issues
performance_optimizations.solution: Implement debouncing and use HapticFeedbackConstants instead of direct vibration
implementation_steps: 1. Replace direct Vibrator usage with performHapticFeedback()
2. Add debounce logic to prevent rapid-fire vibrations
3. Make haptic feedback optional with intensity settings

performance_optimizations.title: Implement Derived State for Tick Updates
performance_optimizations.current_problem: 100ms tick interval causes full UI recomposition
performance_optimizations.solution: Use derivedStateOf and defer state reads to minimize recomposition scope
implementation_steps: 1. Wrap frequently changing state in derivedStateOf
2. Only trigger recomposition when actual visible changes occur
3. Defer state reads using lambda parameters

performance_optimizations.title: Optimize JNI Bridge Calls
performance_optimizations.current_problem: Full JSON snapshot every 100ms is expensive
performance_optimizations.solution: Implement delta updates and selective state querying
implementation_steps: 1. Create separate JNI methods for specific state queries
2. Implement delta/diff system to only send changed data
3. Use protocol buffers instead of JSON for faster serialization
4. Cache unchanged data on Kotlin side
performance_optimizations.estimated_impact: 40-60% reduction in JNI overhead, faster frame times
